headline: Nhan Duc Nguyen moves into ARC-3 gold places

sections.text: Nhan Duc Nguyen climbed from 20th to 8th at 38.84, a 4.10-point gain that moved the team into the 18 gold places.
The gold line rose 0.34 in the past day to 35.79; Son & Mark & Ronen now sit just outside in 19th at 35.45.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
